Canola model options manager — canola
text: options manager configuring canola model parameters. object provides methods get set canola related parameters.

title: Canola model options manager — canola
Canola model options manager — canola
text: phenology.thermal_time.x Cardinal temperatures thermal time calculation. Default: c(2, 30, 35) phenology.thermal_time.y Effective thermal time corresponding cardinal temperatures. Default: c(0, 28, 0) phenology.thermal_time.method Method used thermal time calculation. Supported values: "3hr" "HourlySinPpAdjusted". Default: "3hr" phenology.vernalisation_time.x Cardinal temperatures vernalisation time calculation. Default: c(0, 2, 8, 15) phenology.vernalisation_time.y Effective vernalisation time corresponding cardinal temperatures. Default: c(0, 1, 0.5, 0.0)

title: Canola model options manager — canola
text: get(key) Retrieve value option key (e.g., "phenology.thermal_time.x") set(key, value) Set value option key reset() Reset options default values

title: Canola model options manager — canola
code: # Get default thermal time cardinal temperatures canola$get("phenology.thermal_time.x") #> [1]  2 30 35  # Get default vernalisation time parameters canola$get("phenology.vernalisation_time.x") #> [1]  0  2  8 15 canola$get("phenology.vernalisation_time.y") #> [1] 0.0 1.0 0.5 0.0  # Set custom values canola$set("phenology.thermal_time.x" = c(0, 25, 40)) canola$set("phenology.thermal_time.y" = c(0, 25, 0))  # Reset to defaults canola$reset()
